resources.string: Enter the address of your own Ledgerline server. Nothing leaves your phone until you sign in.
Enter the address of your server.
That does not look like a server address.
The address must start with https://, so your sign-in stays private.
Enter only the server address, without a path, query or user name.
Your session ended, so please sign in again.
You are signed out on this phone. The server could not be reached, so this phone stays listed under Settings, Signed-in devices until you remove it there.

Your phone\'s screen lock or fingerprints changed, so Ledgerline could not open your saved sign-in and signed you out on this phone. Sign in again. The old sign-in stays listed under Settings, Signed-in devices until you remove it there or it expires.
The email or password is not right.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
The server did not accept this address. Check that it is exactly the address you use for the web app.
The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
Could not reach the server. Check your connection and the address.
Something unexpected came back from the server. Check the address and try again.
Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for Ledgerline.
Enter one of your backup codes. Each one works only once.
That code is not right or has expired. Check it, or go back and sign in again.
No accounts yet. Add them in the web app.
Offline. Nothing is saved on this phone yet.
Could not update. Showing what was saved.
Changed on another device, so your change was not applied.
Deleted on another device, so your change was not applied.
The server did not accept it: %1$s

resources.string: Signing out deletes them from this phone. Send them first, or delete them on purpose.
Confirm it is you with your fingerprint or screen lock to open your ledger.
Keep Ledgerline signed in on this phone
That did not work. Try again, or sign in again with your password.
Too many attempts. Wait a little, then try again, or sign in again with your password.
Stay signed in on this phone?
Ledgerline can keep you signed in, protected by your fingerprint or screen lock, so you do not need your password and code each time. Without it you sign in again every time you open the app.
This phone has no fingerprint or screen lock set up, so Ledgerline cannot keep you signed in safely. You will sign in again each time you open the app.
This phone cannot protect a saved sign-in, so you will sign in again each time you open the app.
